name: @lynn123411/dsh-ask-user-grilling
description: Grilling-round question tool: puts the whole round of questions into the conversation as an interactive form and ends the turn there — the user answers it in the native composer and their next message carries the answers back. Its browser half renders that form row (forced multi-select, per-question free text, detail markdown, recommendation badge, import-to-composer button, an unsent-content reminder, and read-only once the round is over).

scripts.test: node scripts/test-recommendation.mjs && node scripts/test-form-model.mjs && node scripts/smoke-host.mjs && node scripts/test-render.mjs && node scripts/smoke-client.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm assert:lib-untracked
